items.title: XRP’s 44% rally brings leverage back, raising risk of sharper pullback
items.snippet: CryptoQuant data show XRP’s estimated leverage ratio on Binance at its highest since January, with long accounts outnumbering shorts as futures volume runs more than five times spot trading.
items.note: Позитивний тон для XRP за ключовими словами.

items.title: Crypto greed gauge hits highest since just before October’s $19 billion wipeout
items.snippet: The Fear & Greed Index reached 74 on Tuesday after sitting at 27 less than two weeks ago, showing how quickly traders have gone from caution to chasing risk.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо загального ринку -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.

items.title: US banking groups plan nationwide blockchain network for 2027
items.snippet: BankChain joins a growing field of bank-led networks building shared infrastructure for tokenized deposits and onchain payments.
items.note: Негативний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: Bitcoin holds $79,000, ether, solana slip as traders bank a week of gains
items.snippet: Every major token fell over 24 hours except HYPE, though bitcoin holds a 23% weekly gain and XRP almost 45%.
items.note: Негативний тон для BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.
